  "decisions": [
    {
      "id": "d1",
      "timestamp": "2026-09-11T15:30:00",
      "phase": "1-architecture",
      "session": 1,
      "decision": "Deliver CraftAssay as an agent skill plus FilePress site plus a tiny TypeScript path catalog. No command-line reviewer.",
      "rationale": "Smell Check, Detangler, Misemphasis, and Cold-eye already prove this shape. The review judgment is host-agent behavior. The spec is the contract. A CLI that called a project-owned model would change the product.",
      "alternatives_considered": [
        "CLI that calls a cloud or local LLM",
        "Hosted review web app with accounts",
        "Spec-only repo with no site"
      ],
      "status": "active"
    },
    {
      "id": "d2",
      "timestamp": "2026-09-11T15:30:00",
      "phase": "1-architecture",
      "session": 1,
      "decision": "craftassay-review-spec-v1.1.md is the review contract. Rubric stays v1.0. Site and skill must not invent extra dimensions, scores, or modes.",
      "rationale": "The spec already defines inventory, evidence, seven dimensions, findings, comparison, and the invocation prompt. Implementation should encode that contract, not replace it.",
      "alternatives_considered": [
        "Rewrite a shorter product spec and treat v1.1 as background",
        "Add a hosted validator that becomes the source of truth"
      ],
      "status": "active"
    },
    {
      "id": "d3",
      "timestamp": "2026-09-11T15:30:00",
      "phase": "1-architecture",
      "session": 1,
      "decision": "Local files only. No PocketBase, no accounts, no project-owned LLM API.",
      "rationale": "Review inputs and reports live on disk. State does not need to outlive the browser as shared product data. Host agent supplies judgment. Matches sibling review skills.",
      "alternatives_considered": [
        "PocketBase plus auth for saved reviews",
        "Runtime LLM API for automated scoring"
      ],
      "status": "active"
    },
    {
      "id": "d4",
      "timestamp": "2026-09-11T15:30:00",
      "phase": "1-architecture",
      "session": 1,
      "decision": "TypeScript ESM, Node >=20, pnpm. FilePress site shipped with getfilepress and Cloudflare Pages.",
      "rationale": "House language and the sibling site stack. User asked for a FilePress site.",
      "alternatives_considered": [
        "SvelteKit app with PocketBase",
        "Static site without FilePress"
      ],
      "status": "active"
    },
    {
      "id": "d5",
      "timestamp": "2026-09-11T15:30:00",
      "phase": "1-architecture",
      "session": 1,
      "decision": "LocalSlip lease craftassay-site on preferred port 5202. Enroll the repo in the workspace LocalHelm fleet.",
      "rationale": "House local-dev tools. FilePress reads the lease and does not claim on dev. 5202 is unused in the published FilePress lease table. LocalHelm needs a fleet row plus pnpm ship for Sites and Ship.",
      "alternatives_considered": [
        "Hardcode Vite 5173",
        "Skip fleet enrollment until after first ship"
      ],
      "status": "active"
    },
    {
      "id": "d6",
      "timestamp": "2026-09-11T15:30:00",
      "phase": "1-architecture",
      "session": 1,
      "decision": "Keep CraftAssay and Cold-eye as distinct review questions. One skill handles initial review and comparison when a baseline is supplied.",
      "rationale": "Spec §0 already defines the relationship. A second comparison package would split the contract. Optional Cold-eye pass stays a recommendation, not a dependency.",
      "alternatives_considered": [
        "Separate craftassay-compare skill",
        "Require Cold-eye before a CraftAssay review"
      ],
      "status": "active"
    },
    {
      "id": "d7",
      "timestamp": "2026-09-11T16:12:00",
      "phase": "1-architecture",
      "session": 1,
      "decision": "Canonical public URL is https://craftassay.dev. https://craftassay.com points at the same site. npm craftassay is already staked.",
      "rationale": "Owner holds both domains and the package name. FilePress url and canonical links use .dev so the two hosts stay one product.",
      "alternatives_considered": [
        "craftassay.com as the FilePress url",
        "Two separate sites"
      ],
      "status": "active"
    },
    {
      "id": "d8",
      "timestamp": "2026-09-11T16:37:00",
